program_source:
"""Reduce completed mixed trajectories and compare the two normalizer maps."""

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import time


HELPER = Path('/tmp/summarize_sparsemax_attention.py')
HELPERS = runpy.run_path(str(HELPER))
ROOT = HELPERS['ROOT']
LABELS = [f'forward-{forward}-backward-{backward}-hard-large-recall-seed{seed}'
          for forward, backward in (('sparsemax', 'softmax'), ('softmax', 'sparsemax'))
          for seed in range(3)]


def collect():
    state = json.loads(Path('/tmp/basis-sparsemax-step3-supervisor.json').read_text())
    if state['phase'] != 'complete':
        raise ValueError('The original mixed-target supervisor has not finished')
    runs = {label: HELPERS['trajectory'](label) for label in LABELS}
    diagonal_path = ROOT / 'attention_targets.json'
    diagonal = json.loads(diagonal_path.read_text())['runs']
    comparisons = {}
    fingerprints = set()
    for label, run in runs.items():
        frames = run['trajectory']
        assert [frame['step'] for frame in frames] == list(range(0, run['stop']['step'] + 1, 50))
        assert all(frame['examples'] == 256 and frame['query_count'] == 2048 for frame in frames)
        assert not any(frame['diagnostic_probe'] for frame in frames)
        fingerprints.update(frame['rows_sha256'] for frame in frames)
        assert run['description']['model']['block']['attention']['weights']['type'] == 'SurrogateWeights'
        weights = run['description']['model']['block']['attention']['weights']
        seed = run['description']['seeds']['model']
        diagonal_label = f'probe-{weights["forward"]["type"].lower()}-hard-large-recall-seed{seed}'
        initial = []
        for name in (diagonal_label, label):
            with (ROOT / 'runs' / name / 'history.jsonl').open() as history:
                observation = json.loads(next(history))
            assert observation['step'] == 0
            initial.append(observation['validation'])
        run['initial_forward_comparison'] = {
            'diagonal_label': diagonal_label,
            'validation_metrics_identical': initial[0] == initial[1],
            'loss_difference': initial[1]['loss'] - initial[0]['loss'],
            'fixed_rows_identical': frames[0]['rows_sha256'] == diagonal[diagonal_label]['trajectory'][0]['rows_sha256']}
        assert run['initial_forward_comparison']['validation_metrics_identical']
        assert run['initial_forward_comparison']['fixed_rows_identical']
        last = json.loads((ROOT / 'runs' / label / 'diagnostics.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()[-1])
        run['last_training_batch_loss'] = last['loss']
        run['final_head_scales'] = last['temperatures']
    for seed in range(3):
        arms = {weights: diagonal[f'probe-{weights}-hard-large-recall-seed{seed}']
                for weights in ('softmax', 'sparsemax')}
        arms.update({f'{forward}_forward_{backward}_backward': runs[
            f'forward-{forward}-backward-{backward}-hard-large-recall-seed{seed}']
            for forward, backward in (('sparsemax', 'softmax'), ('softmax', 'sparsemax'))})
        comparisons[str(seed)] = {name: {'stop': run['stop'], 'best_sequence_accuracy': run['best_sequence_accuracy'],
                                         'last_training_batch_loss': run['last_training_batch_loss']}
                                  for name, run in arms.items()}
    assert len(fingerprints) == 1
    source = Path(__file__).read_text()
    result = {'collected_utc': time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime()),
              'scope': 'Step 3: six mixed hard-large-recall targets, with step-2 diagonals',
              'forward': 'uncompiled_teacher_forced', 'program_source': source,
              'program_sha256': hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest(),
              'helper_source': HELPER.read_text(), 'helper_sha256': HELPERS['sha'](HELPER),
              'diagonal_source': {'path': str(diagonal_path.relative_to(ROOT)), 'sha256': HELPERS['sha'](diagonal_path)},
              'comparisons': comparisons, 'runs': runs}
    (ROOT / 'surrogate_results.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps(comparisons, indent=2), flush=True)
    for label, run in runs.items():
        final = run['trajectory'][-1]
        print(json.dumps({'label': label, 'final_query_attention': final['actual']['supervised_rows'],
                          'wrong_queries': final['wrong_queries'],
                          'wrong_supported': final['wrong_queries_with_answer_in_any_head']}), flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    collect()
